Use case: illustration-story. ONE portrait1088x1920 full-bleed premium family3D animated-feature background. The reference contains the exact ORIGINAL fictional child hosts Matvey the blue-kit raccoon and Sofia the plum-tracksuit orange squirrel. Preserve their faces, ears, age, fur, clothing and proportions. NO humans, human portraits or lookalikes are requested.
Older Madrid football stadium, teaching vignette inspired by the open-roof Bernabeu before redevelopment: steep layered grey-blue stands, pale seating, visible older cantilever roof trusses on long sides, open sapphire twilight sky, emerald pitch, cool pearl highlights and warm light from distant lamps. No modern continuous metal outer shell, no closed rolling roof, no fantasy skyline. Rich detailed architecture, grass and fabric, polished family-feature style.
MAIN COMPOSITION for externally placed actual photographs: TOP60% of the portrait is only beautiful continuous sky/stands, NO heads, ears, limbs, objects or text. Large photo cards will occupy center y=.38–.61, keep this region quiet. The hosts are SMALL supporting guides at the lower left/right edges, not the central subjects: Matvey x=.20, Sofia x=.80. Their full ears begin below y=.66, faces y=.72–.75 (entire face above y=.78), bodies/feet down to y=.92. Each host occupies no more than20% image width. Matvey holds a tiny plain conductor baton playfully at waist level; Sofia points thoughtfully toward the center where the photographs will be added. No football in the illustration. No trophies or equipment hiding their faces. They react quietly and warmly instead of posing as the main heroes.
Premium finely groomed fur, lifelike cloth, clean anatomy, crisp small faces, simple hierarchy, high-end film lighting. No real people, text, lettering, numbers, logos, crests, sponsors, signs, scoreboards, picture frames, borders, panels or watermark. Full background edge to edge, no artificial empty rectangle.
